item.title: Heber Springs teacher posts bond after arrest made over possession of child sexual abuse material
item.description: After David Isaac Gauvey, 30, was arrested during a traffic stop for engaging a child in sexually explicit conduct, as well as possessing and viewing matter depicting child sex, he posted bail.

item.title: History making Central High debate duo reveals secret to success, what's next
item.description: Jack Liu and Shangyu Wu are still riding the high that comes with making history, after being the first Arkansas-based team to ever win the Harvard University National Speech and Debate tournament.

item.title: Art Show at Peake Elementary celebrates student creativity and shines light on local artists
item.description: An art show at Peake Elementary School on Thursday raised money for the school and shone a spotlight on two inspiring local artists.

item.title: Conway County authorities speak on identification of victim in 1994 cold case
item.description: After more than three decades without a name, a woman found murdered along railroad tracks in Conway County has been identified as Jamie Ann Moore of Conway.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.

item.title: FanDuel & DraftKings approved to come to Arkansas despite in-state opposition ‘Game-changer is an understatement’
item.description: The Arkansas Racing Commission has approved FanDuel and DraftKings to enter the state via partnerships with Oaklawn Casino and Southland Casino, respectively, potentially launching before March Madness.
